events.name: Beyond the Demo: Measuring AI That Actually Works for Your Users
events.description: Just because we can build it, doesn’t mean we should. Whether you’re exploring an AI opportunity, running your first experiment, or scaling a live AI feature, the hardest question is the same: Is this creating meaningful value for users, or are we building it because we can? Join us in KL for Beyond the Demo: Measuring AI That Actually Works for Your Users , a practical evening for product, data, analytics, engineering, and design practitioners. We’ll explore four questions teams face on their AI journey: What outcome are we actually trying to change? Can we trust the data we’re measuring? Is AI creating meaningful business value? What do user behaviours reveal about trust and usefulness? Four short practitioner talks, peer-led roundtables, and honest lessons about what works, what doesn’t, and what to try next.
